levels.contraindicated: Should not be used in pregnancy (or in the stated weeks).
levels.avoid: Avoid unless a specialist judges the benefit worth the risk; look for a safer alternative.
levels.specialist: Needs specialist review; do not stop abruptly without advice.

sources.LABEL: Product labelling (CDSCO-approved prescribing information and US FDA labelling, pregnancy sections).
sources.FDA-NSAID-2020: US FDA Drug Safety Communication (15 Oct 2020): avoid NSAIDs at 20 weeks of pregnancy or later because of rare fetal kidney problems and low amniotic fluid.
sources.FDA-STATIN-2021: US FDA Drug Safety Communication (20 Jul 2021): most patients should stop statins once pregnancy is known.
sources.MHRA-VALPROATE: UK MHRA safety measures on valproate (2018, 2024): high risk of birth defects and developmental disorders.
sources.NICE-NG133: NICE guideline NG133, Hypertension in pregnancy: stop ACE inhibitors and ARBs when pregnancy is confirmed (ideally within 2 working days).
sources.WHO-DEWORM-2017: WHO guideline (2017): preventive deworming in pregnancy after the first trimester.
sources.ATA-2017: American Thyroid Association guidelines (2017): in the first trimester propylthiouracil is preferred to methimazole/carbimazole.

groups.label: ACE inhibitor
groups.reason: Fetal kidney damage, low amniotic fluid and skull defects, mainly in the 2nd and 3rd trimesters.

groups.label: Angiotensin receptor blocker (ARB)
groups.reason: Same fetal toxicity as ACE inhibitors.

groups.label: Statin
groups.reason: No benefit during pregnancy for most patients; stop once pregnancy is known.

groups.label: Vitamin K antagonist
groups.reason: Embryopathy (especially weeks 6-12) and fetal bleeding. Women with mechanical heart valves need specialist-managed anticoagulation.

groups.label: Direct oral anticoagulant
groups.reason: Insufficient safety data; heparins are used in pregnancy instead.

groups.label: Oral retinoid
groups.reason: Severe birth defects.

groups.label: Topical retinoid
groups.reason: Retinoid exposure is avoided in pregnancy (tazarotene is contraindicated).

groups.label: Valproate
groups.reason: High risk of birth defects and developmental disorders. Do not stop abruptly in epilepsy; urgent specialist review.

groups.label: Antiepileptic with teratogenic risk
groups.reason: Raised risk of birth defects; benefit usually outweighs risk but needs specialist review. Do not stop abruptly.

groups.label: Methotrexate
groups.reason: Causes miscarriage and birth defects.

groups.label: Mycophenolate / leflunomide
groups.reason: Birth defects and pregnancy loss.

groups.label: Misoprostol / mifepristone
groups.reason: Ends a pregnancy; contraindicated in an ongoing pregnancy unless termination is intended.

groups.label: Ergot uterotonic
groups.reason: Causes uterine contraction; used only after delivery.

groups.label: Tetracycline
groups.reason: Tooth discoloration and bone effects in the fetus, mainly after the first trimester.

groups.label: Fluoroquinolone
groups.reason: Generally avoided in pregnancy when a safer antibiotic is available.

groups.label: NSAID at 20 weeks or later
groups.reason: Fetal kidney problems and low amniotic fluid from 20 weeks; premature closure of the ductus arteriosus in the third trimester. Low-dose aspirin for pre-eclampsia prevention is different and is not flagged.

groups.label: Carbimazole / methimazole in the first trimester
groups.reason: Linked to birth defects in early pregnancy; propylthiouracil is usually preferred in the first trimester.

groups.label: Lithium
groups.reason: Small risk of cardiac defects and neonatal toxicity; needs specialist review and level monitoring.

groups.label: Amiodarone
groups.reason: Fetal thyroid problems and growth effects.

groups.label: Spironolactone
groups.reason: Anti-androgen effects on a male fetus.

groups.label: 5-alpha-reductase inhibitor
groups.reason: Genital defects in a male fetus.

groups.label: Thalidomide and analogues
groups.reason: Severe birth defects.

groups.label: Androgen
groups.reason: Virilisation of a female fetus.

groups.label: Albendazole / mebendazole in the first trimester
groups.reason: Deworming in pregnancy is recommended only after the first trimester.
